status_note: All 43 ordered common-refinement, equivalent-key, erase/zip and stable-cursor observations byte-match locked rangemap.hh. The generic RangeMap template closure covered by this fixture is MATCH; production SymbolEntry/ParamEntryRange/ScopeMapper consumers remain separate TODOs and do not raise their modules above L2.
architecture: host-independent direct template instantiation; linetype=unsigned long long/u64

analysis_options.api: Direct public ghidra::rangemap<TestRecord> and rudra::rangemap::RangeMap<TestRecord> calls; no Architecture, Funcdata, Action, Rule, P-code, SSA, or printer pipeline is constructed
analysis_options.record_type: Inclusive uint64 ranges; TestRecord name is the observable identity; integer Subsort orders by value and uses false/minimum=0 and true/maximum=1000000 on both sides
analysis_options.oracle_build: g++ -std=c++11 -O2 -Wall -Wextra -pedantic against rangemap.hh archived from the locked oracle commit
analysis_options.rugra_build: cargo build --offline --locked --lib from repository commit 8012627083360e0111506dc70d891552383a8c65 with only src/rangemap.rs overlaid, followed by direct rustc compilation of the Rust fixture
analysis_options.iteration_observable: Each line records record names in raw PartIterator/RangeMapIter order. Repeated names are preserved and expose common-refinement multiplicity. begin_list/records order is separately recorded. Live cursors are retained across mutations and dereferenced without re-querying.
analysis_options.mutation_observable: Insert observations include both hinted and unhinted comparator-equivalent positions. Stable cursors cover insertion before/after, equivalent-key insertion, and unzip. Erase observations retain all pre-erase output and expose direct part invalidation, zip-left invalidation, zip-right survival, end stability, left/right sewing, and remaining record-list order.
analysis_options.invalid_cursor_observation: The C++ fixture never compares or dereferences an invalid iterator (which would be undefined behavior). Its three invalid labels are derived from the locked erase/zip statements and the std::multiset rule that erase invalidates only erased elements; the Rust side computes the corresponding safe cursor_is_valid results. All retained-cursor dereferences and erase-through-cursor cases are executed behaviorally on both sides.
analysis_options.normalization: none; Ghidra and Rugra stdout are compared byte-for-byte, with no ID, order, multiplicity, boundary, or state normalization
analysis_options.random_seed: none; all operations and output are deterministic

cases: equal_after_a/equal_after_b/equal_after_hi/equal_after_lo: exact-range insertions expose Ghidra's hinted-before and unhinted-after equivalent-key positions after every mutation
equal_range/equal_subsort_window/equal_ordered_walk: equal ranges, equal sub-sorts, distinct sub-sorts, find overload bounds, full partition walk, and record-list walk
wide_first_left/middle/right/walk: wide [100,140] then narrow [110,120], covering both unzip boundaries and every refined unit
narrow_first_left/middle/right/walk: identical ranges inserted in the opposite order, requiring the same common refinement and ordered partition walk
split_before_erase/split_three_way: outer, inner, and right-overlap ranges produce five boundary units and a three-record middle query
erase_inner_zip_left/erase_inner_middle/erase_inner_overlap: erasing the inner range sews its left boundary while preserving the boundary required by the right overlap
erase_right_zip_both/erase_right_outer: erasing the right overlap removes the remaining unnecessary boundaries and leaves one outer partition
gap_hit/gap_miss/inside_order: find_overlap starts at lower_bound(point), distinguishes a reachable next partition from a gap miss, and returns the minimum sub-sort in a containing unit
bounded_walk: find_begin(304) through find_end(316) preserves every visited refined partition and duplicate record
equivalent_split/equivalent_split_middle: two equal full ranges and an equal-subsort cutter exercise hinted insertion order while unzip splits comparator-equivalent entries
equivalent_erase_cut/equivalent_erase_peer: erase and zip retain Ghidra's equivalent multiplicity/order before reducing to one record

cursor_insert_before_initial/after/erase: canonical counterexample A [100,110], retain its iterator, insert B [50,60], then erase through the retained iterator; A remains selected and B remains in the map
cursor_insert_after/cursor_insert_after_erase: inserting a later disjoint key does not invalidate or retarget the retained A cursor
cursor_equivalent_after/cursor_equivalent_erase: hinted-before and unhinted-after equivalent B parts bracket A without retargeting A's iterator
cursor_unzip_after/cursor_unzip_erase: unzip mutates the original wide part in place and the retained cursor continues to erase wide rather than the newly inserted narrow record
cursor_end_insert: a retained past-the-end iterator remains equal to end after insertion

cursor_matrix_before/after/right_erase: erasing inner invalidates its own part, zip-left removes the retained left outer part, zip-right removes the middle outer part, the right outer part extended in place survives and can erase outer, and end remains stable

input_manifest.canonicalization: SHA-256 of the UTF-8 input_manifest object before adding canonicalization/sha256, json.dumps sort_keys=true, separators=(',',':'), ensure_ascii=false

decisive_semantics.references_and_outputs: MATCH: record and refined-part identity are preserved; RangeMapCursor uses owner_generation plus stable part_serial, cross-map cursors are rejected, and erase/zip invalidate only removed parts.
decisive_semantics.loop_bounds_and_order: MATCH: inclusive first/last refinement, lower/upper bounds, begin/end walks and equivalent hinted/unhinted insertion positions preserve locked multiset order without normalization.
decisive_semantics.counters_and_accumulators: MATCH: f advances only after a refined unit, final unhinted insertion still occurs after exact-end break, new parts receive monotonic serials, unzip keeps the original right serial, and clear cannot alias old cursors.
decisive_semantics.sort_and_comparison_keys: MATCH: the tree key remains exactly (last,subsort); owner_generation and serial are identity-only and never participate in ordering or equivalent-key tie breaking.
